summary: Concurrent synchronous workflow calls no longer hold database connections while waiting for execution results.

evidence: Codex and Astra reviewed the shared request-session boundary under the user’s authorization to fix, merge, and deploy. Real-PostgreSQL regression tests cover workflow sync/async, provider cache misses, and inline execution. Controlled local load reproduced 16 caller timeouts before the fix; the same load passed afterward, with all executions also succeeding at 32 and 64 callers. Pool sizes, resource limits, authorization, and admission pacing are unchanged.
